name: Sugarcane-based spirits
description: These are distilled alcoholic beverages made from fermented sugarcane juice, syrup, or molasses. They include rum, cachaça, rhum agricole, and aguardiente, with flavors ranging from grassy and fresh to caramel, vanilla, and spice depending on raw material and aging. They are used in cocktails such as daiquiris, caipirinhas, and rum-based tiki drinks.
